entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

A Got kemichu wun'ug
Ni kam sumniyeg
Ni ngug mathange—luwol.
Nigem mug liyor ngom.
Gum nang ni gage darity
Rogog ma gure gab fala—ab.
Dariy rebe Got ni taareb
Rogon ngom mi wod
Fanam mathange luwol.
